items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I know Wilders, but I didn't have to go to Wilders, Davenport. He taught trumpet over there.

ctx.x: Okay, and could you tell me some more about who your teachers were at that time?

Well, I know Wilders, but I didn't have to go to Wilders, Davenport. He taught trumpet over there. He had a lady named Ms. Jenkins, she taught piano. Mm-hmm. And another lady named Ms. Chatters, she and I, we went to school together. I don't know what she was teaching, but I didn't have to go to her. We had Quentin Batiste, he was teaching theory. He was teaching Schellinger. We had Clyde Kerr, Sr. He was over there teaching band stuff. Spencer, Mr. Spencer, he was teaching bass.
